randarts.name: +2 hat of the Fletcher {rN+}
randarts.description:
A cloth hat. 

Base armour rating: 0

rN+:       It protects you from negative energy.

It cannot be enchanted further.

If you switch to wearing this armour:
Your AC would remain unchanged.
Your EV would remain unchanged.

This armour is useless to you right now: you can't equip that in your current form.

This ancient artefact cannot be changed by magic or mundane means.
You acquired it on level 2 of the Dungeon.

Stash search prefixes: {inventory} {artefact} {artifact} {helmet armour} {helmet armor} {auxiliary armor} {auxiliary armour}
Menu/colouring prefixes: identified artefact armour

randarts.name: ring of Ytsoe {rF+++ Will+ MP-9 Str+3}
randarts.description:
It is an ancient artefact.

rF+++:     It renders you almost immune to fire.
Will+:     It increases your willpower.
MP-9:      It affects your magic capacity (-9).
Str+3:     It affects your strength (+3).

You acquired it on level 2 of the Dungeon.

Stash search prefixes: {inventory} {artefact} {artifact} {rF+} {jewellery} {resist fire} {fire resistance}
Menu/colouring prefixes: identified artefact jewellery
